findings.message: "#scene-2" has CSS `transform: translateX(1920px)` and a GSAP tween animates x. GSAP will overwrite the full CSS transform, discarding any translateX(-50%) centering or CSS scale value.
findings.fixHint: Remove `transform: translateX(1920px)` from CSS and replace with GSAP properties: x: 1920. Example: tl.fromTo('#scene-2', { x: 1920 }, { x: 1920, ...yourAnimation }). tl.fromTo is exempt from this rule.
